title: Spawn only where an enemy can reach the player
intent: Keep locked areas empty without per-area rules, so a wave can always be cleared

evidence.description: added canSpawnAt and the flow-field reachability check
0 of 15 spawns landed in the Narrow Alleys before the gate opened, 6 of 17 after

constraints.statement: WaveDirector uses a spawn point only when canSpawnAt(point) is true, wired to nav.isReachable on the flow field toward the player; nothing spawns behind the closed alley gate
A spawn point is also at least 400 px from the player, off screen with a 64 px margin, and 48 px from any living enemy
